description: Safety hooks: reject a `git add` that would stage a .env, key, certificate, or credentials file (the pathspecs it names, and for broad adds what git status lists), reject Edit/Write calls on lock files and on node_modules/, vendor/, and .git/ paths, and reject single file writes over 1,048,576 characters. Pattern-based, so it does not catch everything; see the README. Requires jq.

hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ogxo-guards/env-file-guard: jq not found; this hook is inactive. Install jq to enable it." >&2; exit 1; }; bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/env-file-guard.sh"

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ogxo-guards/file-protection: jq not found; this hook is inactive. Install jq to enable it." >&2; exit 1; }; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; case "$f" in */node_modules/*|*/vendor/*|*/.git/*|*package-lock.json|*yarn.lock|*pnpm-lock.yaml|*bun.lockb|*Cargo.lock|*go.sum|*Gemfile.lock|*poetry.lock|*uv.lock) echo "BLOCKED: $f is a generated or vendored file. Change the source (e.g. package.json) and regenerate instead." >&2; exit 2 ;; esac

command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "ogxo-guards/large-file-guard: jq not found; this hook is inactive. Install jq to enable it." >&2; exit 1; }; sz=$(jq -r '.tool_input.content // "" | length'); if [ "${sz:-0}" -gt 1048576 ]; then echo "BLOCKED: Write of ${sz} characters exceeds the 1MB limit. Generate large files with a script instead." >&2; exit 2; fi
